info.name: SAML Provider
info.summary: Use Nextcloud as a SAML 2.0 Identity Provider
info.description:
# SAML Provider for Nextcloud
Use your Nextcloud accounts to sign in to external SAML 2.0 compatible services.
## Features
- Service Provider initiated single sign-on (SSO) - Identity Provider initiated login from a user-facing launcher - Signed SAML Responses and Assertions using RSA-SHA256 - Metadata endpoint for straightforward service onboarding - Per-service Entity ID, ACS URL, NameID format, attributes, and certificate settings - Optional verification of signed AuthnRequests
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 33 or later - HTTPS for Nextcloud and connected services - PHP OpenSSL and DOM extensions
## Getting started
1. Open **Administration settings → SAML Provider**. 2. Generate the IdP signing certificate. 3. Register the displayed metadata URL with your SAML-compatible service, or enter the Entity ID, SSO URL, and public certificate manually. 4. Add that service's Entity ID and ACS URL as a connected service. 5. Test login before disabling a local login method in the connected service.
The app sends `uid`, `displayName`, and `mail` attributes when they are available in the Nextcloud user profile.
See the project README for setup instructions, a complete Kimai example, security guidance, and limitations.
